mapper.sql: select cast(u.id as char) id,u.username,u.display_name displayName, cast(u.department_id as char) departmentId,d.name department,u.enabled from sys_user u join sys_department d on d.id=u.department_id
mapper.select: where u.deleted=0 order by u.id
where u.deleted=0 and u.id=#{id}
select cast(r.id as char) from sys_role r join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id=r.id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.deleted=0 order by r.id
select r.name from sys_role r join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id=r.id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.deleted=0 order by r.id
select count(*) from sys_user where id=#{id} and deleted=0
select id from sys_user where username=#{username}
mapper.update: update sys_user set display_name=#{displayName},department_id=#{departmentId},updated_by=#{operator} where id=#{id} and deleted=0
update sys_user set enabled=#{enabled},updated_by=#{operator} where id=#{id} and deleted=0
update sys_user set password_hash=#{passwordHash},updated_by=#{operator} where id=#{id} and deleted=0
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_role where id=#{id} and deleted=0 and enabled=1
select count(*) from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=#{userId} and r.code='ADMIN' and r.deleted=0

select count(distinct u.id) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.id join sys_role r on r.id=ur.role_id where u.deleted=0 and u.enabled=1 and r.code='ADMIN' and r.deleted=0 and r.enabled=1
select id from sys_role where code='ADMIN' and deleted=0

select cast(d.id as char) id,cast(d.parent_id as char) parentId,d.code,d.name,d.sort_order sortOrder,d.enabled, (select count(*) from sys_user u where u.department_id=d.id and u.deleted=0) userCount from sys_department d where d.deleted=0 order by d.sort_order,d.id
select count(*) from sys_department where id=#{id} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sys_department where id=#{id} and deleted=0 and enabled=1
select id from sys_department where code=#{code}
mapper.update: update sys_department set enabled=#{enabled},updated_by=#{operator} where id=#{id} and deleted=0
mapper.select: select parent_id from sys_department where id=#{id} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sys_department where parent_id=#{parentId} and deleted=0 and enabled=1
select count(*) from sys_department where parent_id=#{parentId} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sys_user where department_id=#{departmentId} and deleted=0 and enabled=1
select count(*) from sys_user where department_id=#{departmentId} and deleted=0
select count(*) from pr_requisition where department_id=#{departmentId} and deleted=0

select cast(r.id as char) id,r.code,r.name,r.data_scope dataScope,r.enabled,r.built_in builtIn, (select count(*) from sys_user_role ur join sys_user u on u.id=ur.user_id and u.deleted=0 where ur.role_id=r.id) userCount from sys_role r where r.deleted=0 order by r.id
select cast(permission_id as char) from sys_role_permission where role_id=#{roleId} order by permission_id
select code,built_in builtIn from sys_role where id=#{id} and deleted=0
